work.title: Shenoute: Uncertain Xr

paragraphs.text: [?] many peoples estranged from God through defilement, impurities, thefts, and every evil deed. This is how it will be in the last days for anyone who wants to be righteous among those who live [?] in this place, whether male or female, will be compelled by God to be faithful among many peoples estranged from God through filth, deceit, and every kind of lawlessness.

And at that time, theft, falsehood, laughter, mockery, their ridiculing one another, slander, grumbling, excessive ambition, and favoritism. and insatiability, boasting, blasphemy with idle words, fights, rivalries, hatred, jealousy, hostility, quarrels with one another, and foolishness, and ignorance—these and many other things will no longer be counted as sins by the ungodly who will be among you at that time, whether male or female.
And because their evil deeds have multiplied, they will not understand that the children who have become defiled are estranged from God, according to the Scriptures.

For this reason, the sexual immorality of their hearts will exceed the sexual immorality of their laps, and the sexual immorality of their laps will exceed the sexual immorality of their hearts. And these two will rise up against them, as they become entangled in eating, drinking, and abundant luxury, especially as they abound in idleness and leisure and neglect all the righteousness of God.

And because they have not put to death their members that are on earth—sexual immorality, impurity, negligence, and all the rest—Satan will rise up against them with all his defiling powers, which we drive out of all the congregations and out of them. And they will commit acts of sexual immorality, defilement, and impurity, and many deceptions, through Satan and his unclean spirits, who counsel with me about the evil that will happen at that time.
And at that time, righteousness, truth, and every kind of diligence will hide themselves from those unclean people, and lying and negligence will assert themselves boldly over them.
But righteousness, truth, and every kind of diligence will not hide themselves from the faithful who will live at that time—or rather, even now. And it will never happen.
Nor will lawlessness, lying, and every kind of negligence assert themselves boldly over the faithful who will live at that time—or rather, even now. And it will never happen.

For this reason, just as now every believer in every congregation belonging to our way of life—or rather, everyone who fears him— the Lord everywhere—acts boldly in all righteousness and every good deed, trampling on every kind of lawlessness and deceit,

so also the believers who will exist at that time will act boldly in righteousness and every good deed here, together with everyone everywhere, and they will trample upon [?] Satan and all his filth and all his impurities. Neither the devil nor a sinful person nor any lawlessness whatsoever will be able to hinder them at any time, as they cry out to the Lord in truth.

Rather, they will prevail mightily over Satan and all his other evil deeds, and they will show themselves righteous through the abundance of their righteous deeds in the midst of the wicked people who will exist at that time, like Abel, who was righteous in every kind of righteousness in the midst of Cain, who was truly ungodly beyond all people,
and like Enoch and Noah and all the others who were righteous in every kind of righteousness in the midst of all those whom God wiped from the earth in a great flood of water,
and like Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who were righteous in every kind of righteousness in the midst of all who oppressed them,
and like Lot in the midst of the people of Sodom and Gomorrah, who were truly ungodly and more wicked than all other people, according to the Scriptures,

and like Moses, Aaron, Miriam, and Joshua, who were righteous in every kind of righteousness in the midst of the disobedient, the grumblers, those who committed sexual immorality, and those who craved foods that were not before them,
and like the judges, who were righteous in every kind of righteousness in the midst of all those, some of whom abandoned God and followed foreign gods.
Not only did the holy people please God among those of their own number who became ungodly, but they also proved truly good and faithful before the Lord among the nations that do not know God.

And all the prophets, all the apostles, all the saints, and everyone who fears the Lord, from the beginning down to this very day. have been righteous in every kind of righteousness among those who are godless [?] and abominable before God, from the beginning until now.
We have spoken of these people in this way so that we may understand that, just as neither the devil nor anyone who sins has been able to prevent any person from the beginning until now,
so they will never be able to prevent them, because Jesus himself is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

Everyone who wants to fulfill all righteousness follows the good desires of their hearts through God. And everyone who wants to carry out their evil deeds at all times follows the evil desires of their hearts through Satan.
But just as all the saints suffered distress in the midst of the ungodly who have existed from the beginning,
so also the righteous will suffer distress in the midst of all the ungodly in every congregation belonging to our way of life, and in every place throughout the whole earth where people sin.
And so also the believers who will be among you in the last days will suffer very great distress.

And just as the prophet’s word is fulfilled at this present time against every congregation that exists in our lifetime, because of [?] within them: “How have you turned into a bitter vine that has become estranged from God through all its impurities and abominations?”

So too, at the last time, the prophet’s word will be fulfilled against those who live in this place because of those among them who will sin, whether male or female. as he says: “The Lord called their name ‘an olive tree, beautiful to look at, providing shade.’ At the sound of its stripping, however, a fire has now blazed up against it.”
Great is the affliction that is upon [?].
For its branches have become useless, from the beginning until now, and forever.

For everyone who sins anywhere in the whole earth, the words of the prophets are fulfilled concerning them, saying, “I will sing to the beloved about my vineyard with a song of love.” And after all the words he spoke that follow these, he says, “I waited for it to produce grapes, but it produced thorns.”
Look, the rest of these words are on the sheets written earlier.
And just as a righteous king, for his part, is in harmony with those who belong to him and is always among them,

And whenever their enemies come to fight against them and all those who belong to the king, they rise up against their enemies and overtake them, and they do not return until they have destroyed them.
so too, whenever everyone keeps the Lord’s commandments in every congregation, in every place throughout the whole earth, God is with them.

And whenever Satan rises against them to wage war on them, they call on the name of the King of glory, Jesus, the mighty Lord, the strong one, the Lord who is powerful in battle. And he sends them help through his holy angels, and they pursue the demonic enemies—all those with whom the Lord is present—and they do not turn back until they have destroyed Satan and all his other evil works.

Therefore, just as all our holy fathers, from righteous Abel down to today, pursued Satan and every evil deed out of themselves and out of their congregations, their sons, their daughters, their brothers, their companions, and everyone who fears the Lord, who had received instruction and obeyed them in everything,

so too, now and forever, all who keep God’s commandments pursue the devils and all their other works out of themselves, like people pursuing robbers who want to plunder houses full of silver and gold. And they pursue them within their congregations like people pursuing wild beasts that want to seize and scatter the sheep of the flock.

And they pursue them out of their sons, their daughters, and their companions, like people pursuing foxes that want to ruin very fine vineyards, as the Scriptures say: “Catch for me the little foxes that ruin the vineyards.”
And in the same way, they also drive them out of everyone who fears the Lord, receives their instruction, and keeps their words.

And if everyone at all times pays attention to what they do in every good work, and does not waver in the teaching of those who teach them from the Scriptures In the fear of the Lord they will pursue Satan and every evil deed and blow them away by the power of God’s Spirit, like chaff that a wind carries far away in its strength, and which no one will ever fear—dust and straw that the wind blows away from the face of the whole earth, as the Scriptures say.

So too, at all times and forever, we will never fear tens of thousands of demons fighting against us all around, as it is written. But just as Satan has prevailed from the beginning over everyone because of their evil deeds,
so too he prevails over everyone who tells lies and disobeys those who teach them from the Scriptures in the fear of the Lord—

Therefore, if people sin while others are pleading with them not to sin, then how much lawlessness will be committed people who love evil—when those who command them not to sin before the Lord depart from them.
And this is how Moses spoke in his distress: “While I am still with you, you provoke God. How, then, will you not provoke him after my death?”

Therefore, it is no wonder that some of us sinned while our holy fathers who have fallen asleep were pleading with us. Nor is it any wonder that they sinned after our holy fathers who have fallen asleep departed from us.

It is no wonder if they sin while our fathers who are with us now plead with us, weeping over us and urging For they were forcefully commanding us to keep the commandments and solemnly charging us by the Lord Jesus not to act deceitfully before the Lord.
Nor, again, is it any wonder if we sin when our fathers who are with us now, who grieve over us day and night, depart from us.
Has any prophet, then, ever arisen in Israel like Moses?
And great multitudes sinned after he had departed from them, and after he had instructed them with all his words, after they had seen many wonders.
Is there anyone superior to all the prophets? Yet great multitudes sinned after the prophets had commanded them through all their words, and after they had seen many wonders.
Is there anyone greater than Jesus, the Son of God? Yet great multitudes sinned after he had instructed them with all his words, and after they had seen countless signs and wonders.

Is anyone, then, as mighty in power as our fathers the apostles? Yet great multitudes sinned after the apostles had instructed them with all their words, after they had seen many signs and wonders. If, then, all these people sinned while all these holy people were with them, each in his own time,
And the Lord Jesus himself, the Son of God, was with them on earth.

And all those who fell away from the hope of eternal life sinned. It was not only that many peoples sinned while these saints were with them, but many peoples, beyond counting, also sinned after all these holy people had departed from them on the day of their visitation,

just as we ourselves now sin, or have sinned, after hearing the words of all these saints, those of the apostles, those of the prophets, and those of our Lord Jesus, and those of all our fathers from the beginning—Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—and all the words of everyone who fears the Lord, down to this very day.
And if, after all these things, we sinned before the Lord, not only in our fathers’ house, in our childhood and our ignorance, but also after we had received a share in the knowledge of the truth,

And if those who want to fulfill their desires at all times sin fearlessly before the Lord, like the angels who left behind their own authority and committed sexual immorality with the daughters of the people of ancient times, and like all the others who have sinned from the beginning until now,

then who is Shenoute, or what are all his words, that he should be able to prevent or restrain evil-loving people among us, whether male or female, who want to carry out their sins at all times, with deceit, theft, false oaths, fighting, and false accusations against one another, like the man who falsely accused his brothers, saying that they had sinned, without knowing whether they had sinned or had not done so?
But in fact it is he who sinned in many ways: first, he defiled the temple of God in his childhood.

And when he confessed his sexual immorality, at the time when the fear of the Lord was examining him through the person questioning him, who wanted to help him, to take him out of Satan’s hands, to pull him out of the mire of lawlessness, and to save him from God’s wrath.
yet again, after some years, he turned back and denied the truth, though no one questioned him.
